title: SiPearl delivers first homegrown server chips for Europe's exascale supercomputer
content: SiPearl, a fabless company backed by the European Union and France, has delivered the first Rhea1 CPU samples to Bull for integration into Europe's JUPITER supercomputer, moving the European-designed processor from bring-up and validation into customer system integration while benchmarking continues.

title: Anthropic, OpenAI expected to start buying memory directly in 2027
content: Anthropic and OpenAI are expected to start buying memory directly from manufacturers in 2027 as model developers take greater control of chip and data-center design, potentially broadening the customer base for major memory suppliers beyond GPU and system vendors.

title: Vivo unveils X500 strategy to bolster premium phone push
content: Vivo unveiled its new X500 series imaging flagship phones in Shanghai on September 21, 2026, aiming to build a stronger moat in mobile imaging and break through more aggressively in the premium smartphone market. As rising memory prices force handset makers to lift retail prices, IDC expects worldwide smartphone shipments to fall 16.7% in 2026 to just over 1 billion units.

title: Changs Ascending eyes AI data center backup power, storage growth
content: Changs Ascending's board approved an operating plan on Sept. 21 to launch an energy systems integration push into the AI data center sector, betting on structurally rising demand from AI computing centers for stable power, backup power, and ESS. The lithium battery materials maker aims to extend its proven UPS, lithium iron phosphate battery and BESS integration capabilities in semiconductor sites into AI data center power infrastructure as the next growth engine for its energy business.

title: China prepares business delegation as Xi seeks steadier US trade ties
content: China is preparing a business delegation for President Xi Jinping's Washington visit as Beijing pursues more predictable trade relations and opportunities for companies facing US market-access barriers. The preparations combine official economic talks with a proposed corporate entourage, although the sources reviewed have not publicly confirmed the individual executives attending.

title: Meta's AI agent Muse tops app charts, driving AMD's market cap past US$1 trillion
content: Meta's new AI agent, Muse, has leapt to the top of app charts roughly two weeks after its release. Its popularity has helped push up chip stocks by focusing attention on the importance of CPUs for agentic AI.

title: Hermes Testing sees growth opportunity in AI-driven chip demand as OTC debut expands reach
content: Hermes Testing Solutions began trading on the over-the-counter market on September 22, positioning itself to benefit from rising demand tied to artificial intelligence and high-performance computing. The semiconductor wafer testing provider is also expanding into high-speed memory SLT, advanced packaging equipment, and SiPh CPO testing.

title: Acer debuts first Googlebook with 360-degree hinge
content: Acer has launched its first Googlebook, a new flagship notebook equipped with Gemini Intelligence that combines premium materials, strong performance, smart features, and seamless syncing with Android phones. The Acer Googlebook 14 is also the first convertible Googlebook on the market.

title: Microsoft opens fourth India cloud region, casting Hyderabad as an AI hub for Asia and the Global South
content: Microsoft has turned a headline slice of its US$20.5 billion India commitment into operating infrastructure, opening a Hyderabad cloud region it intends to serve customers well beyond India's borders. The move positions the country as a supply base for AI compute at a moment when it generates far more data than it can process at home.

title: Hanmi Semiconductor ships first FC Bonder 75 for 2.5D packaging
content: Hanmi Semiconductor said on September 22 that it has shipped its first FC Bonder 75 to a customer, expanding the South Korean equipment maker's reach beyond high-bandwidth memory (HBM) into the broader system semiconductor packaging market.

title: Alibaba speeds V900 rollout, targeting 20GW of data centers
content: Alibaba Group is accelerating the rollout of its next-generation Zhenwu V900 accelerator by about six months as it expands a vertically integrated computing platform spanning processors, networking, storage and data centers.

title: Taiwan virtual asset law to help lower supply chain transaction costs
content: Taiwan's Legislative Yuan passed the Virtual Asset Service Act in June 2026, and Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) is now drafting delegated regulations, with completion planned for the first quarter of 2027. PwC Taiwan managing director Monica Lee said banks will need licenses to operate virtual asset services, and lending licenses are the most likely to be profitable.

title: DeepSeek bets on Huawei chips for model training as Nvidia's China sales slip
content: DeepSeek CEO Liang Wenfeng said during a call with investors that he aims to rely on Huawei chips to train the startup's models in the future, and that a batch of training chips from Huawei are set to begin arriving at his company as early as the fourth quarter of 2026.

title: DEEPX targets smart glasses with low-power NPU, eyes 6G AI RAN
content: South Korean AI semiconductor company DEEPX is reportedly conducting a proof of concept with a US smart glasses company to test whether its low-power neural processing unit (NPU) can balance power consumption, thermal performance, and AI computing capability.

title: Micron Taiwan union heads for strike vote as board, earnings calendar stall profit-sharing talks
content: The labor dispute at Micron Taiwan continues to escalate after Micron and the Taiwan Taoyuan Union failed to reach agreement at a second mediation meeting on September 21, 2026.
